paragraphs.text: As a computer engineering student based in Barcelona focusing on backend development, this Junior Backend Developer position directly matches my practical background in Python, SQL, and REST APIs.

I have hands-on experience building backend services in Python. For my Home Network Monitor project, I developed a FastAPI backend that scans local network devices and serves status data to an HTML dashboard. I also developed a Python scraper scheduled via GitHub Actions to automate flight price monitoring.
In addition, during my internship as a Technical Consultant Intern in Barcelona, I regularly validated application data using SQL queries and tracked defects in Jira within an Agile banking project.
